evidence: Alters descriptor parsing/expansion in src/script/descriptor.cpp and updates wallet import behavior tested in test/functional/wallet_importdescriptors.py.
rationale: Warns users against silent key reuse and address clustering when importing multipath descriptors with single-path expressions. As described in issue #35985, descriptor expansion previously cloned single-path keys across branches without notifying the user, creating privacy and clustering risks between receive and change outputs.
